??? example "Dispatches inside a closure listener"

    ```php title="app/Providers/AppServiceProvider.php"
    namespace App\Providers;

    use App\Events\InvoiceSettled;
    use App\Events\PaymentReceived;
    use App\Jobs\ProcessOrder;
    use Illuminate\Support\Facades\Event;
    use Illuminate\Support\ServiceProvider;

    class AppServiceProvider extends ServiceProvider
    {
        public function boot(): void
        {
            Event::listen(PaymentReceived::class, function ($event) { // → closure_listeners.queued false
                event(new InvoiceSettled); // → closure_listeners[PaymentReceived].dispatches.target InvoiceSettled

                collect([1, 2])->each(fn () => ProcessOrder::dispatch()); // → closure_listeners[PaymentReceived].dispatches.target ProcessOrder
            });
        }
    }
    ```

    ```php title="app/Events/PaymentReceived.php"
    namespace App\Events;

    class PaymentReceived {} // → events[PaymentReceived].handled_by []
    ```

    ```php title="app/Events/InvoiceSettled.php"
    namespace App\Events;

    class InvoiceSettled {} // → events[InvoiceSettled].dispatched_from []
    ```

??? example "Closure registrations"

    ```php title="app/Providers/EventServiceProvider.php"
    namespace App\Providers;

    use App\Events\OrderPlaced;
    use App\Events\OrderShipped;
    use Illuminate\Foundation\Support\Providers\EventServiceProvider as ServiceProvider;
    use Illuminate\Support\Facades\Event;

    class EventServiceProvider extends ServiceProvider
    {
        protected $listen = [
            OrderPlaced::class => [
                fn (OrderPlaced $event) => null, // → closure_listeners.registration listen_array
            ],
            'orders.archived' => [
                function ($event) {}, // → closure_listeners.event orders.archived
            ],
        ];

        public function boot(): void
        {
            Event::listen(OrderPlaced::class, fn ($event) => null); // → closure_listeners.registration event_listen_call
            Event::listen(function (OrderShipped $event) {}); // → closure_listeners.event OrderShipped
            Event::listen(fn (OrderPlaced|OrderShipped $event) => null); // → closure_listeners.event OrderPlaced → closure_listeners.event OrderShipped
            Event::listen(fn ($event) => null); // ✗ untyped_closure_listener
            Event::listen(fn (object $event) => null); // ✗ untyped_closure_listener
            Event::subscribe(\App\Listeners\OrderSubscriber::class);
        }
    }
    ```

    ```php title="app/Listeners/OrderSubscriber.php"
    namespace App\Listeners;

    use App\Events\OrderShipped;
    use Illuminate\Events\Dispatcher;

    class OrderSubscriber
    {
        public function subscribe(Dispatcher $events): array
        {
            return [
                OrderShipped::class => fn (OrderShipped $event) => null, // → closure_listeners.registration subscriber
            ];
        }
    }
    ```
